```plato

// A correlation coefficient in [-1, 1] together with the statistic used and
// the number of paired observations behind it.
type CorrelationCoefficient
    implements IValue
{
    Statistic: CorrelationStatistic;
    Value: Number;
    SampleCount: Integer;
}

// An ordinary least-squares line y = Slope * x + Intercept. RSquared is the
// coefficient of determination in [0, 1].
type LinearFit
    implements IValue
{
    Slope: Number;
    Intercept: Number;
    RSquared: Number;
}

// A least-squares polynomial fit. Coefficients[k] multiplies x^k (ascending
// powers). RSquared is the coefficient of determination in [0, 1].
type PolynomialFit
    implements IValue
{
    Coefficients: Array<Number>;
    RSquared: Number;
}
```
